actions.name: Multi Headed
actions.description: Effect: The user's Physical- and Special-Category attacks without @Trait[x-strike] gain +10% Power for each head the user has (from @Trait[x-Headed]). @Trait[x-strike] attacks hit an additional number of times for each head the user has (from @Trait[x-headed]), and increases the @Trait[x-strike] trait by the value of @Trait[x-headed].
